Shell(python -c " import re, json html = open('missav_home_ok.html', encoding='utf-8').read() links = re.findall(r'href=\"(/cn/[a-z0-9\-]+?)\"', html) seen = [] for l in links: if l not in seen and '-chinese-subtitle' not in l and '-uncensored' not in l and l not in ('/cn','/cn/'): seen.append(l) cards = [] # 抓典型图片+链接对 for m in re.finditer(r']+href=\"(/cn/[a-z0-9\-]+?)\"[^>]*>(.*?)', html, re.S): href, inner = m.group(1), m.group(2) if '-chinese-subtitle' in href or '-uncensored' in href: continue img = re.search(r']+(?:data-src|src)=\"([^\"]+)\"', inner) alt = re.search(r'alt=\"([^\"]*)\"', inner) if img and len(inner) > 300: cards.append({'href': href, 'img': img.group(1)[:100], 'alt': alt.group(1) if alt else ''}) open('card_sample.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(cards[:8], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)) print('cards found:', len(cards)) ")
